summary: Stage 2B Driver Portal frontend smoke test complete against live preview. Login as testdriver@example.com lands on /driver with dark 'Hi Test' header, Pending pill, and driver-warning-card. All dashboard sections render: section-earnings, section-fleet (fleet-empty-cta), section-upcoming (upcoming-empty), section-bids, section-rating, section-verification. SideRail on desktop shows Home/Available/My Jobs/Earnings/Fleet/Profile (6 items). Session restoration via HttpOnly cookie works on reload (no JWT/auth keys in localStorage/sessionStorage — only PostHog analytics keys). Global search opens via driver-search-open and calls /api/search on typing; ESC closes. Available Jobs (/driver/jobs) renders with search bar, advanced-toggle, sort chips (nearest/newest/highest_price/distance_asc); advanced-filters panel exposes radius-10/20/40/75/250 chips and radius-20 click triggers /api/jobs/nearby refetch (verified). reset-filters testid is present in code but only rendered when activeFilterCount>0 (conditional — matches spec). Driver Job Detail (/driver/job/{id}) on 2 seeded jobs (both bidding and fixed) correctly shows pending-approval-warning and gates bid-box / accept-fixed-box — matches expected behaviour for pending driver. My Jobs shows driver-my-jobs + my-jobs-empty for new driver. Earnings shows earnings-hero, earnings-pending, earnings-inprogress, earnings-info, earnings-empty. Fleet: fleet-empty + fleet-add opens fleet-modal with fleet-vehicle-type (SELECT with 16 options), fleet-registration, capability chips (fleet-cap-*), and fleet-modal-save POSTs to /api/driver/vehicles → backend accepted (200) even for pending driver, modal closed on success (this is backend behaviour, not a frontend bug — the frontend correctly wires error surfacing via fleet-modal-error if a rejection occurred). Documents renders driver-documents with 6 required rows (driving_licence, insurance_certificate, profile_photo, proof_of_address, vehicle_photos, vehicle_registration); doc-upload-driving_licence + setInputFiles triggers POST /api/users/me/documents with {doc_type,base64} → 200, row transitions to Pending. Profile renders header, status pill, open-documents/open-fleet/open-settings and driver-logout. Logout calls POST /api/auth/logout (200) and returns to /auth/login. RBAC: unauth /driver → /auth/login?next=%2Fdriver ✓; customer login → /driver redirects to /customer (RequireRole works). Regression: testcustomer@example.com login lands on /customer without errors. Zero requests to maps.googleapis.com across the whole driver session. No AIzaSy key present in DOM.

integration_issues.flow: Foreground tracking + POD upload + Chat send
integration_issues.issue: NOT EXERCISED on the positive path — pending driver has no assigned bookings, so start-tracking-button, submit-pod, and driver-chat-send could not be tested against a real assigned booking. Frontend wiring reviewed: BookingDetail.jsx uses navigator.geolocation.watchPosition with 30m/45s throttle and POSTs /api/tracking/:id; POD uses <input capture='environment'> + SignaturePad canvas; chat POSTs /api/bookings/:id/messages — all error paths surface via location-error / pod-error / chat error inline. To fully verify happy-path, a booking must be admin-assigned to testdriver@example.com and paid.

action_items: (INFO) To exercise the happy-path for tracking / POD / chat, seed an assigned+paid booking for testdriver@example.com via admin, then a follow-up test can drive start-tracking + set_geolocation + POD upload + chat send.
critical_code_review_comments: Fleet.jsx save(): POST /api/driver/vehicles currently succeeds for pending drivers on this backend build — no bidding/tracking-style guard. If the product requires blocking vehicle registration until documents are approved, that gate must be enforced backend-side; frontend correctly surfaces server errors via fleet-modal-error when they occur.
Documents.jsx: POST /api/users/me/documents also succeeds for pending drivers (row transitions to Pending). Frontend surfaces errors via docs-error only in the catch branch — good.
Jobs.jsx line 251: reset-filters is only rendered when activeFilterCount>0. This is intentional but the review checklist should note the conditional visibility (not always present).
JobDetail.jsx: pending-approval-warning is shown before bid-box / accept-fixed-box so pending drivers cannot submit bids or accept fixed jobs — matches spec.

SignaturePad.jsx (116 lines) is a clean canvas port with mousedown/mousemove/mouseup handlers; touch handlers should also be wired if not already present for mobile POD capture — not exercised in this run.
BookingDetail.jsx (802 lines) is over the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting Overview/Chat/POD/Tracking into sub-components for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 6 driver screens + RBAC + regression pass; tracking/POD/chat positive-path not exercised because pending driver has no assigned booking — negative-path wiring verified)

test_credentials: testdriver@example.com / DriverTest12345! (pending) and testcustomer@example.com / CustomerTest12345! — both worked from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: During the fleet test one vehicle (registration 'TEST12345', vehicle_type='motorcycle_courier', one capability enabled) was created on testdriver@example.com — /api/driver/vehicles returned 200. During the documents test one driving_licence document (1x1 PNG) was uploaded — /api/users/me/documents returned 200 and the row is now in Pending state. Neither affects other portals; can be cleaned up via admin if desired. Two customer-side test jobs from iteration_2 (4af865af... fixed, f508aa78... bidding) were also viewed via /driver/job/{id} — no writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage 2B driver portal is functional end-to-end for the pending-driver negative path. To validate the happy path for tracking / POD / chat, admin-assign testdriver to a paid booking (or use the conftest driver fixture) and re-run start-tracking/POST-tracking, submit-pod, and driver-chat-send with Playwright's context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation. Preview URL: https://cargo-repo-bridge.preview.emergentagent.com. Cookie: cargoone_session (HttpOnly). Zero google-maps requests, no AIzaSy key.
